title: An example of the non-existence of coequalizers in the category of the A$_{\infty}$-categories
summary: We prove that the categories of strictly unital (resp.\ non unital) A$_{\infty}$-algebras and A$_{\infty}$-categories, with strictly unital (resp.\ non unital) A$_{\infty}$-morphisms and A$_{\infty}$-functors have no coequalizers.
